user.title: Connect to OnFeather
user.description: The address of your `of-free` server. A trailing `/v1` is fine — it will be trimmed.

data_description.api_key: Only if the server was started with ONFEATHER_API_KEY set. Leave empty otherwise.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the router. Check the address, and that `of-free serve` is bound to an address Home Assistant can see rather than to localhost.
error.invalid_auth: The router refused this API key.

abort.already_configured: This router is already set up.

data_description.model: `auto` lets the router pick per request. `private` forces a local model. Anything else pins one provider/model pair.
data_description.prompt: The system prompt. Leave empty for the Home Assistant default.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Which APIs the model may call to act on your home. Leave empty for a conversation agent that can only talk.
data_description.max_history: Older turns are dropped before sending, because free tiers have small context windows. 0 keeps everything.
